summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs (with _0x-style obfuscated identifiers) downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the binary, then invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` banner, a rotating string-array decoder (rotator WV8StW, decoder hc1jfK9), and randomized identifiers, and is only reachable through this preinstall-triggered Bun invocation. The package's stated purpose is a trivial monorepo test helper exporting a `Hello ${name}` string; that purpose does not require an alternate runtime or a multi-hundred-kilobyte loader. The alternate-runtime execution path defeats Node-level inspection, and the obfuscated payload's actual behavior cannot be determined without instrumented execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
